_comment: Reviewed exceptions of the translation quality gates (scripts/catalog/__tests__/translationQuality.test.ts). sameAsEnglish: English descriptions whose Spanish name is legitimately the same text (loanwords used as such in Spanish, dishes and drinks with an international name, brand and restaurant names). englishWords: tokens allowed in Spanish names although they are English words (initials of brand names). englishWords also holds the names of regional dishes calculated from recipes (scripts/catalog/data/recipes/): they are Spanish or Portuguese loanwords that the English names and aliases of those dishes also use.
